tools.name: list_places
tools.description: Use it when the person asks where this site's yachts leave from, or a place name they said is shared by two places. It answers how many regions, countries, areas, towns and bases there are, then one page of those places, each with its id and how many yachts are there now, read from the live inventor

tools.name: get_yacht
tools.description: Use it once the person names or picks one yacht from a search_yachts or best_deals answer: pass its page link, exactly as that answer returned it, as id. It answers the yacht's facts and terms as the source states them (packages, included, required and optional extras, deposit, check-in days and tim

tools.name: price_range
tools.description: Use it when the person asks what a stay costs and has no exact days or yacht yet. tools.name: best_deals
tools.description: Use it when the person asks for deals, specials, discounts or last-minute offers. It answers discounted departures of this site's yachts, read from the live inventory: only a discount the source itself states (a special, or a price under its list price), never a computed gap; by default from tomorro

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Use it only after the person chose one or more yachts from a search_yachts, best_deals or get_yacht answer, gave their days and party, and said yes to a written quote: ask them before you call it. Pass the page links exactly as those answers returned them, the days, the party and anything they want

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "best_deals" stacks urgency/override words (never, mandatory). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_yachts, get_yacht, best_deals · Private data: search_yachts, best_deals · Public sink: search_yachts, get_yacht, price_range, best_deals, request_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_yachts, get_yacht, best_deals · Private data: search_yachts, best_deals · Public sink: search_yachts, get_yacht, price_range, best_deals, request_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

detail: Tool "search_yachts" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
